name: Project Pandora
source:
An amnesiac girl named Ia wakes up to find herself trapped in a mysterious, prison-like facility with a bloodthirsty warden. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240329182052/https://knivves.itch.io/project-pandora]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫艾亚的失忆女孩醒来，发现自己被困在一个神秘的、类似监狱的设施里，还有一个嗜血的典狱长。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240329182052/https://knivves.itch.io/project-pandora]itch.io[/url]]
